name: Interactive sound map of SRX's ecological reserve
dialogues: The eco-brigades of Santa Rosa Xochiac (SRX) reserve were looking to attract tourism and support to protect the SRX reserve
The reserve has a large territorial extension and one of its attractions is the sighting of different species and natural landscapes
Proposed, along with a team, an interactive sound map as support for the tour of the reserve
The map also serves as a guide to learn more about the flora and fauna of the reserve
Designed the high-fidelity prototype, accessing from a main screen to information about the different species and location of sightings
Facilitated coordination between multidisciplinary teams, promoting agreements
